store.summary: GPS speed, motion-state logger with waypoints for vehicles (ESP32 port)
store.description: Logs a vehicle's GPS track to daily CSV files named by local date, exactly like the JP226-GPS-IMU-Logger ESP32 firmware: 1 Hz while moving, every 15 minutes then hourly while stopped, once a minute with no fix. Reads NMEA from a serial GPS (device and baud auto-detected), rejects implausible fixes, follows the Australian time zone offline from the GPS position, and saves a waypoint with one key press. Pages: speed, GPS status, logger status, waypoint, diagnostics. IMU and OBD-II hooks are present but not wired yet.
